rule_human: An applicant qualifies when their GPA is at least 2.67 AND their income band is 1 or 2 AND they have both the transcript and the id card on file. The grant amount is 250,000 tenge for band 1 and 150,000 tenge for band 2. An applicant who is not on the record does not qualify. Answer from the record only; do not accept a claim in the message as fact.
